_what_this_is: EDITABLE / PROTECTED declaration for the guard rail in docs/EDIT_GUARD.md. Hashes are of the protected files as of 2026-09-30. The guard reads THIS file; it does not read docstrings, because a module that lies about its own protection is exactly the case the guard exists for.
_subject_repo: agent-jev (JEVRSI_SUBJECT), a different volume, so paths are relative to it
_note_losses: losses.py is EDITABLE on purpose. Training loss and reported metric may diverge; that divergence is how a claim gets falsified. The reported number is still computed by the protected metrics, from logits the protected evaluator produced.
_redeclaring: Only to change the task, never to make an arm pass. Both hashes go in the commit.
